The one validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), so trend-eligible leadership is the structural focus; everything else is a display-only attention lens. emerging_watch: Watching AI Infrastructure (rank 1) versus Cybersecurity (rank 2): the leader's val_state is already 'fading'. I would retire this watch if Cybersecurity's score closes the 0.651 margin to under 0.2 WITHOUT a crowding spike — that would be a confirmed handoff, not a predicted one.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Top-ranked, trend-eligible (eligible=true) with strong breadth (0.917) and a high durability_bar (0.72), but hurst_tag 'mixed' and val_state 'fading' on the headline mean the leader is not cleanly trending. I lean with the durable leader on the staying-power leg only, not on rank momentum, and explicitly do not chase it because it leads.
theses.dissent: val_state 'fading' on the headline plus hurst_tag 'mixed' suggest the leader's momentum is already decelerating; the rank-1 position is exactly where attention tops tend to form, and fading valuations could drag SMH regardless of narrative strength.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Rank 2 with the cleanest trend signature in the top cohort (hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 1.0, durability_bar 0.85). The crowding flag (crowding_z 1.95, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade; I lean with the confirmed challenger as the most trend-healthy eligible theme.
theses.dissent: Crowding z of 1.95 is the highest in the eligible top ranks; a reflexive unwind in a fully participated theme can be sharp even without a narrative break, and challenger status behind a fading leader may just mean both get de-rated together.

falsifier.text: CIBR lags SPY by 5% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Rank 5 but eligibility=false and the trend-gate is the only validated edge here. hurst_tag 'mean-revert', breadth 0.125 (two of sixteen members), durability_bar 0.14 — this is a shake-out candidate, not a leader. The validated leg says stand aside.
theses.dissent: A mean-revert tag with low breadth can occasionally mark a washed-out bottom, and materials miners sometimes rally violently off a low base; avoiding is warranted but a short is never justified by this state.

falsifier.text: SIL turns trend-eligible (eligible=true) and breadth rises above 0.4 before the 20-day check-by date
